memory_note: I ordered French toast at Sierra Café and thought it was extremely delicious.
caption: French toast at Sierra Café in Auckland. The memory describes it as very delicious, with condensed milk sweetness blending into the cake.

memory_note: We walked to Albert Park and took a group photo in front of the fountain.
caption: A group photo of four friends in front of a fountain at Albert Park in Auckland. Everyone looks happy.

memory_note: After a tiring climb and a risky shortcut, the whole city of Auckland could be seen from the top.
caption: A photo of me standing at the top of Mount Victoria with open arms, with Auckland city views in the background.

memory_note: I took a photo with one of the Hobbit houses and thought the small houses were very cute.
caption: A photo with a small Hobbit house at Hobbiton Movie Set. The memory describes the small houses as very cute.

memory_note: Inside a Hobbiton house, I saw a very cute children's bunk bed.
caption: A cute children's bunk bed inside one of the Hobbiton houses.

memory_note: At the end of the Hobbiton visit, I drank ginger beer from a cute brown cup.
caption: A hand holding ginger beer in a cute brown cup at Hobbiton Movie Set.

memory_note: The driver found wild feijoa fruit and let us taste it. It was sour and sweet.
caption: A small pile of feijoa fruit picked from the roadside during the return trip to Auckland.

memory_note: The butter chicken with garlic naan was extremely delicious.
caption: Butter chicken curry with garlic naan at an Indian restaurant in Auckland.

memory_note: We ate a highly rated taco near the lake. It was juicy and tasted very good.
caption: A hand holding a juicy taco near the Queenstown lakefront.

memory_note: We took the Skyline gondola to reach a higher viewpoint over Queenstown.
caption: A photo of me and my friend inside the gondola going up to the Skyline viewpoint.

memory_note: From the top, the scenery looked wide and beautiful.
caption: A wide view of Queenstown from a high viewpoint, showing mountains, lake, and open scenery.

memory_note: The luge ride was a little exciting and fun.
caption: A photo related to riding the luge at Skyline Queenstown.

memory_note: My down jacket was torn while queueing for the luge, so I used bandages to patch it in a cross shape.
caption: A down jacket repaired with two bandages in a cross shape after it was accidentally torn.

memory_note: I ate cream pasta with lots of basil and really liked the texture.
caption: Cream pasta with many basil leaves in Queenstown.

memory_note: On the way to Milford Sound, we stopped at Fiordland National Park and took photos with the mountains.
caption: A portrait standing on grass with large mountains behind at Fiordland National Park.

memory_note: We took a boat at Milford Sound and experienced the beauty of the fjord landscape closely.
caption: A view of Milford Sound fjord scenery from the boat cruise.

memory_note: We ate the famous Fergburger and donuts. Both were very delicious, but I forgot to take food photos.
caption: The sign of Fergburger in Queenstown. The burger and donut were memorable even though only the sign was photographed.

memory_note: We passed Mount Cook on the road from Queenstown to Christchurch. There was already snow on the mountain peak.
caption: Snow visible on the peak of Aoraki / Mount Cook in April.

memory_note: The lake reflection looked even bluer than the sky, and I took a photo I really liked.
caption: A photo near the Church of the Good Shepherd where I smiled brightly, with the lake scenery nearby.

memory_note: On the way to dinner, we saw an arch-like landmark in Christchurch at night.
caption: A night photo of Christchurch's arch-like Bridge of Remembrance.

memory_note: We ordered different brunch dishes and shared them. I still thought my avocado toast was the best.
caption: Four different brunch dishes placed together at Unknown Chapter in Christchurch.

memory_note: During the city walk, I felt tired, and my two friends tried to lift me up. We all laughed.
caption: A playful photo where two friends lifted me up at Victoria Square.

memory_note: I noticed there were many small trams in Christchurch.
caption: A street photo of the Christchurch Tram passing through the city.

memory_note: We saw a famous Christchurch attraction that looked like a suspended or floating house.
caption: A photo of the famous floating or suspended house landmark in Christchurch.

memory_note: I took a lively photo with the beautiful fountain and felt very happy.
caption: A lively portrait in front of a beautiful fountain at the entrance of Christchurch Botanic Gardens.

memory_note: The falling leaves made me feel that autumn had really arrived.
caption: Autumn leaves falling in Christchurch Botanic Gardens.

memory_note: At Christchurch Airport, I noticed the toilet signs were respectful of gender diversity.
caption: A toilet sign at Christchurch Airport showing male, female, and all-gender accessibility.
